35389185.clinical_problem: Characterizing amygdala and hippocampal subfield volume differences in infants with autism spectrum disorder using MRI segmentation.
35389185.patient_population: Infants 6-24 months, later diagnosed with ASD vs typically developing controls
35389185.model_description: Takes infant brain MRI as input and outputs segmented amygdala and hippocampal subfield masks for volumetric analysis.

35654376.clinical_problem: Automatically extracting and aligning the fetal brain from 3D ultrasound scans to enable neuroimaging analysis of fetal brain development.
35654376.patient_population: 356 fetal head 3D ultrasound scans, gestational age 14-30 weeks
35654376.model_description: Takes 3D fetal head ultrasound scans as input and outputs a brain extraction mask and an aligned brain image in a standard coordinate space.
35654376.release_evidence: The BEAN implementation and related code can be found under www.github.com/felipemoser/kelluwen.
35654376.dataset_size: 356 fetal head 3D ultrasound scans (14-30 weeks gestation)
35654376.headline_result: Mean Dice Similarity Coefficient 0.94 for brain extraction, 0.93 for alignment
35654376.study_design: retrospective methods development and internal validation study

35845049.exclusion_reason: Clinical/laboratory prediction model for preeclampsia delivery timing using maternal biomarkers and clinical data, not radiologic image analysis.

35885422.exclusion_reason: Classification uses 3D photogrammetry/statistical shape modeling of head surface, not a radiologic imaging modality (X-ray/CT/MRI/US).

36094660.clinical_problem: Prenatal prediction of placenta accreta spectrum using MRI to inform delivery planning.
36094660.patient_population: 407 pregnant women undergoing preoperative MRI at two institutions
36094660.model_description: Combines a clinical prediction model, a radiomics model, and a deep learning model based on T2-weighted MRI features to predict placenta accreta spectrum before delivery.
36094660.dataset_size: 407 pregnant women (298 training, 75 internal validation, 34 external test)
36094660.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development with external validation

36213312.exclusion_reason: Adult midlife cohort study (Dunedin birth cohort followed to age 45); not a pediatric population.

36245889.clinical_problem: Differentiating adolescents with major depressive disorder from healthy controls using resting-state brain connectivity patterns.
36245889.patient_population: 71 adolescents with major depressive disorder and 71 matched healthy controls
36245889.model_description: Uses voxel-wise degree centrality features from resting-state fMRI as input to a support vector machine classifier that outputs a diagnostic label distinguishing MDD from healthy controls.

36532197.clinical_problem: Estimating individual brain maturation (brain age) in children with ADHD compared to unaffected siblings and healthy controls using structural MRI.
36532197.patient_population: 89 children with ADHD, 34 unaffected siblings, 21 healthy controls, mean age ~12 years
36532197.model_description: Takes structural brain MRI as input and outputs an estimated 'brain age' (BrainAGE index) compared against chronological age.
36532197.headline_result: ADHD brains estimated 0.85 years younger than controls (Cohen's d=-0.33, p=0.028)

36564934.clinical_problem: Automatically classifying fetal movement from continuous fMRI to relate fetal motor behavior to brain network dynamics and postnatal motor outcomes.
36564934.model_description: A deep-learning model extracts the fetal brain from 4D fMRI time-series data, from which frame-wise displacement is calculated to classify periods of fetal movement.

37576451.clinical_problem: Aligning brain MRI images across modalities (T1 and T2) in neonates for cross-modality analysis.
37576451.patient_population: Neonatal T1-T2 brain MRI registration dataset
37576451.model_description: Learns multi-scale local patch features projected into a shared embedding space to enable unsupervised deformable registration between T1- and T2-weighted neonatal brain MRI scans.

31503129.exclusion_reason: Clinical decision-support model combining physical exam, laboratory markers, and a binary ultrasound-visualization finding via a neural network; not an image-analysis AI model.

33378589.clinical_problem: Automated diagnosis of autism spectrum disorder in children using task-based fMRI responses to a speech task.
33378589.model_description: Extracts BOLD signal features from task-fMRI via discrete wavelet transform compression, then a 2D convolutional neural network classifies children as ASD or typically developing.

33624844.exclusion_reason: Structural MRI morphometry and mediation analysis of childhood TBI outcomes; no AI/ML model described.

33894243.clinical_problem: Distinguishing adolescents with conduct disorder from typically developing controls using dynamic resting-state brain activity patterns.
33894243.patient_population: 18 adolescents with conduct disorder, 18 typically developing controls
33894243.model_description: Uses dynamic regional homogeneity features from resting-state fMRI as input to a linear support vector machine classifier distinguishing conduct disorder patients from controls.

34133034.exclusion_reason: Adult point-of-care ultrasound study (inferior vena cava collapse assessment); no pediatric population stated.

34136818.exclusion_reason: Adult chest CT population (mean age 65 years); pediatric mentioned only as a keyword tag, not a study population.

34540764.exclusion_reason: Automated perfusion quantification pipeline 'previously developed in adults'; no explicit AI/ML method described in the abstract.

34617030.clinical_problem: Automated quantification of abdominal adipose tissue depots (visceral and subcutaneous fat) in neonates and young children using MRI.
34617030.patient_population: 333 neonates (<=2 weeks) and 755 children (4.5 or 6 years) from the GUSTO cohort
34617030.model_description: A convolutional neural network takes abdominal MRI volumes as input and outputs segmentation masks for superficial subcutaneous, deep subcutaneous, and visceral adipose tissue.
34617030.dataset_size: 1,088 volumes (333 neonates, 755 children); trained on 761, tested on 100 neonatal + 227 child volumes
34617030.study_design: retrospective secondary analysis of prospectively collected cohort data

34710247.model_family: classical ML (region merging, trainable Weka segmentation)
34710247.clinical_problem: Segmenting and classifying first-trimester fetal brain ultrasound images to measure fetal cerebral cortex for earlier detection of brain abnormalities.
34710247.patient_population: First-trimester fetuses undergoing nuchal translucency scans (normal and increased NT groups)
34710247.model_description: Applies two segmentation methods (Statistical Region Merging and Trainable Weka Segmentation) to fetal brain ultrasound images to measure the fetal cerebral cortex.

35063339.model_family: unsupervised multiple kernel learning + k-means clustering
35063339.clinical_problem: Identifying patient subgroups (phenogroups) in pediatric dilated cardiomyopathy associated with risk of death or heart transplant, using echocardiographic strain and Doppler data.
35063339.patient_population: Pediatric dilated cardiomyopathy patients and healthy controls, echocardiographic and clinical data
35063339.model_description: Uses whole cardiac-cycle strain, Doppler velocity traces, age and body surface area as input to unsupervised machine learning (multiple kernel learning and k-means clustering) to group patients into phenotypic clusters associated with death or transplant risk.
35063339.study_design: retrospective cohort study with interpretable machine learning

32542779.clinical_problem: Denoising and suppressing artifacts in arterial spin labeling MRI to improve cerebral blood flow measurement with fewer repetitions.
32542779.patient_population: 131 pediatric neuro-oncology patients (training), 11 healthy adult subjects (evaluation)
32542779.model_description: A denoising autoencoder with stacked convolutional encoding/decoding layers takes a single ASL subtraction image and outputs a denoised perfusion image comparable in quality to averaging 10 acquisitions.
32542779.headline_result: 62% average SNR gain; 75% reduction in kinetic-model fitting error

32583085.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of cerebrospinal fluid and brain volume on MRI in children with hydrocephalus to track ventricular size over time.
32583085.patient_population: 43 patients with pediatric hydrocephalus, 95 MRI sequences
32583085.model_description: A convolutional neural network, initialized from a pre-trained VGG16 model and fine-tuned via transfer learning, segments MRI into brain, CSF, background, and tissue classes.
32583085.headline_result: Global accuracy 0.90, Dice coefficient 0.86 on test data
32583085.study_design: retrospective methods development and validation study

32677744.exclusion_reason: Adult women's national survey study on mammography utilization factors; not pediatric, not an image-analysis AI model.

32916543.clinical_problem: Automatic recognition of dyslexia in children using brain activation patterns from task-based fMRI during reading tasks.
32916543.model_description: Three parallel 3D convolutional neural networks, each processing brain activation maps from a different reading task, are concatenated to classify children as dyslexic or not.

32916583.exclusion_reason: Systematic review of ADHD/rolandic epilepsy comorbidity and neuroimaging/EEG findings; not focused on AI/machine learning methods.

33103162.clinical_problem: Learning representations from fetal ultrasound video and sonographer narration without manual annotation, to support standard-plane detection.
33103162.patient_population: Multi-modal fetal ultrasound video and speech-audio dataset
33103162.model_description: Uses cross-modal contrastive learning between ultrasound video and sonographer speech audio (self-supervised, no manual labels) to learn representations transferable to fetal standard-plane detection and eye-gaze prediction.

33363064.exclusion_reason: Non-invasive fetal electrocardiography technique for cardiotocography; not a radiologic imaging modality and no AI/ML component described.

34367687.exclusion_reason: Uses histopathology/biopsy images of the small bowel (Celiac Disease), not radiologic imaging.

31112785.clinical_problem: Correcting topological errors (handles/holes) in reconstructed infant cortical surfaces from brain MRI to enable accurate early brain development studies.
31112785.patient_population: Infant brain MRI (human), also validated on macaque infant MRI
31112785.model_description: An anatomically constrained deep learning network iteratively identifies and corrects candidate voxels with topological defects in segmented infant brain MRI to produce topologically accurate cortical surfaces.
31112785.study_design: retrospective methods development study, validated on simulated and real topological errors

31632332.model_family: machine learning (radiomics: decision tree, SVM, others)
31632332.clinical_problem: Distinguishing neonatal acute bilirubin encephalopathy from normal myelination using MRI radiomics features.
31632332.patient_population: 32 neonates with acute bilirubin encephalopathy, 29 age-matched controls
31632332.model_description: Radiomics texture features extracted from T1-weighted MRI regions of interest are fed into multiple machine learning classifiers (decision tree, SVM, etc.) to distinguish ABE from normal myelination.

31755665.clinical_problem: Predicting persistent post-concussion symptom recovery in children using structural and functional brain MRI markers of the default mode network.
31755665.patient_population: 110 children with mixed recovery following mild traumatic brain injury
31755665.model_description: Combines gray matter volume (voxel-based morphometry) and resting-state functional connectivity MRI features using machine learning to predict individual recovery from persistent post-concussion symptoms.
31755665.headline_result: AUC 0.86 predicting clinical outcome at follow-up

31760495.clinical_problem: Predicting optimal versus suboptimal spontaneous lumbar curve correction after selective thoracic fusion in adolescent idiopathic scoliosis using radiographic parameters.
31760495.patient_population: 71 Lenke 1 adolescent idiopathic scoliosis patients with 2-year follow-up
31760495.model_description: Radiographic spinal parameters (Cobb angles, kyphosis, rotation, translation) are used as input to a decision tree model that predicts optimal versus suboptimal spontaneous lumbar curve correction after surgery.

31993109.clinical_problem: Automatically describing the clinical workflow of full-length routine fetal anomaly ultrasound scans by classifying scan sections.
31993109.patient_population: Full-length fetal anomaly ultrasound scan videos
31993109.model_description: 2D and 2D+t CNN, LSTM, and convolutional LSTM architectures process full-length fetal ultrasound video to automatically partition and label scan sections for workflow analysis.

28439522.clinical_problem: Automated quality assessment and biometric measurement (biparietal diameter, occipital-frontal diameter, head circumference) of the fetal head on 2D obstetric ultrasound.
28439522.model_description: Texton-based segmentation extracts the fetal head region; shape and anatomic features are fed into a random forest classifier to assess image quality and derive fetal head biometry.
28439522.study_design: retrospective methods development and validation study

28656614.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of renal cortex, medulla, and collecting system on dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI to estimate glomerular filtration rate in children.
28656614.model_description: A modified iterative graph-cut (GrabCut) segmentation combined with a random forest classifier segments the kidney into cortex, medulla and collecting system from dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI, used to estimate GFR.
28656614.headline_result: F1=0.93 whole-kidney, F1=0.86 cortex; GFR estimation error 2.98+/-0.66%

28852853.clinical_problem: Predicting risk of symptomatic cerebral vasospasm after aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage in children using an adult-derived neural network model applied to pediatric clinical and radiographic data.
28852853.patient_population: 16 pediatric patients (<21 years) with aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage
28852853.model_description: An artificial neural network trained on adult aneurysmal subarachnoid hemorrhage data is applied to pediatric demographic, clinical, and radiographic variables to output a likelihood score for symptomatic cerebral vasospasm.
28852853.headline_result: ANN correctly predicted all 16 outcomes; mean prediction strength -0.86 (no vasospasm) vs 0.93 (vasospasm case)

27445675.clinical_problem: Identifying a common pattern of structural brain alterations distinguishing young children with autism spectrum disorder from controls using structural MRI.
27445675.patient_population: 41 children with ASD (21M/20F), 40 controls (20M/20F), ages 22-72 months
27445675.model_description: Regional structural features from brain MRI are used to train a one-class support vector machine on the ASD group alone, which then classifies new subjects as ASD or outliers (controls).

27648848.exclusion_reason: Conventional fMRI activation and voxel-based morphometry statistical analysis; no AI/ML classifier described.

25379446.clinical_problem: Determining which white matter tracts independently contribute to language impairment in children with epilepsy and cortical malformations, using diffusion tensor imaging.
25379446.patient_population: 33 pediatric patients with malformations of cortical development and epilepsy, ages 3-18
25379446.model_description: Diffusion tensor imaging metrics (mean diffusivity, fractional anisotropy) from six white matter tracts are analyzed using a random forest machine learning algorithm to determine each tract's independent contribution to language impairment.

25467807.clinical_problem: Automated detection of endotracheal tube presence and tip location on pediatric chest radiographs to identify malposition.
25467807.model_description: Line-tracing features from the cervical region are combined and classified using a support vector machine to detect endotracheal tube presence, then multiple thresholds determine the tube tip location.
25467807.headline_result: Az (AUC) 0.943+/-0.009 for tube detection; tip location error 1.89+/-2.01 mm

24282501.model_family: machine learning (unspecified classifier) on structural connectivity networks
24282501.clinical_problem: Predicting neurological outcome in neonates with neonatal encephalopathy using brain structural connectivity networks derived from diffusion tractography.
24282501.patient_population: Cohort of patients with neonatal encephalopathy
24282501.model_description: Diffusion tractography-derived structural brain networks are mapped to a high-dimensional feature space and standard machine learning algorithms predict neurological outcome, validated with nested cross-validation.

18850125.model_family: artificial neural network / support vector regression
18850125.clinical_problem: Semi-automated segmentation of fetal ultrasound images to improve estimated fetal weight via standard biometric measurements.
18850125.patient_population: 215 fetuses; 103 used for weight estimation within 3 days of delivery
18850125.model_description: A semi-automated segmentation system measures biparietal diameter, head circumference, abdominal circumference, and femur length from fetal ultrasound images, feeding these into regression, artificial neural network, and support vector regression models to estimate fetal weight.
18850125.headline_result: Mean absolute percentage error reduced from 6.71% (manual) to 4.66% (computerized)

40250104.clinical_problem: Integrating multimodal brain imaging (fMRI, DTI, sMRI) to predict cognitive function and characterize brain connectivity during youth development.
40250104.patient_population: Human Connectome Project Development (HCP-D) cohort of youth
40250104.model_description: A graph neural network integrates functional connectivity (fMRI), structural connectivity (DTI), and anatomical features (sMRI) parcellated with the Glasser atlas, using a masking strategy for interpretability, to predict cognitive function and analyze brain connectivity in youth.
40250104.study_design: retrospective cohort study using a public multimodal neuroimaging dataset

37774112.exclusion_reason: Clinical/biomarker prediction model for pre-eclampsia using maternal characteristics, serum biomarkers, and a Doppler pulsatility-index value; not an image-analysis AI model.

38461322.clinical_problem: Automated quality assessment and view/plane segmentation for fetal echocardiography to support the 18-22 week anomaly scan.
38461322.patient_population: 5,363 images from 2,551 pregnancies (training/validation); 100 patients prospective validation (192 images)
38461322.model_description: A deep learning model auto-captures and segments fetal echocardiography images, assigning a quality score that determines segmentation reliability, validated prospectively against clinician review.
38461322.dataset_size: 5,363 images from 2,551 pregnancies; prospective validation of 192 images from 100 patients
38461322.headline_result: Overall segmentation accuracy 0.91 (SD 0.09); 0.97 for above-average quality images
38461322.study_design: retrospective model development with prospective clinical validation

38701657.clinical_problem: Estimating white matter fiber orientation distribution in newborns and fetuses from limited diffusion MRI measurements, enabling microstructure assessment when only a few measurements are feasible.
38701657.patient_population: Newborn and fetal diffusion MRI datasets, external clinical validation datasets, and post-mortem histological validation
38701657.model_description: A deep learning model maps as few as six diffusion-weighted MRI measurements to fiber orientation distribution functions, trained against multi-shell high-angular-resolution ground truth, validated across scanners and against histology.
38701657.headline_result: Agreement rate 77.5%/22.2% for 1/2-fiber voxels (3%/5.4% higher than other DL methods); angular error 10/20 degrees (6/5 degrees lower)
38701657.study_design: retrospective methods development with external and histological validation

38758252.exclusion_reason: Study explicitly excludes pediatric radiographs from its cohort; adult chest radiograph population only.

38800118.clinical_problem: Reviewing how AI (machine learning, NLP, neural networks, computer vision) can be applied throughout pregnancy for early detection, monitoring and risk assessment of feto-maternal health.
38800118.model_description: Narrative review describing applications of AI subfields (machine learning, NLP, artificial neural networks, computer vision) across feto-maternal healthcare, including fetal ultrasound analysis for abnormality detection.

38824716.clinical_problem: Synthesizing anatomically accurate fetal head standard-plane ultrasound images to augment training data for automated fetal head standard-plane classification.
38824716.model_description: A conditional GAN uses class activation maps as priors during adversarial training to generate synthetic fetal head standard-plane ultrasound images, used to augment classifier training data.
38824716.headline_result: Frechet inception distance 88.52; classifier accuracy improved by 3.2% using synthetic images

38984984.clinical_problem: Predicting 2-year neurodevelopmental outcome (death or impairment) in neonates with hypoxic-ischemic encephalopathy using multisequence brain MRI and basic clinical variables.
38984984.patient_population: 414 term neonates from the HEAL trial across 17 institutions
38984984.model_description: A deep learning classifier takes T1-weighted, T2-weighted, and diffusion tensor MRI plus sex and gestational age as input to predict death or neurodevelopmental impairment at 2 years.
38984984.study_design: retrospective secondary analysis of multicenter randomized trial data (HEAL trial), with in- and out-of-distribution testing

36752863.exclusion_reason: Radiomics feature reproducibility study (intraclass correlation of 2D vs 3D ROIs); no machine learning/AI predictive model applied.

36755050.clinical_problem: Automated classification and segmentation of the placenta on obstetric ultrasound to standardize detection of placenta previa.
36755050.patient_population: 7,500 training images; 100 second-trimester images from Barcelona (cross-validation cohort)
36755050.model_description: A deep learning model trained on manually annotated ultrasound images classifies and segments the placenta, compared against annotations from 25 clinicians of varying experience.
36755050.headline_result: Classification accuracy 81%; IoU 0.78 (model) vs 0.75 (best clinician); external cohort accuracy 76%, IoU 0.68

36794166.model_family: machine learning (KNN, random forest, SVM, LightGBM)
36794166.clinical_problem: Predicting extrathyroidal extension of papillary thyroid carcinoma in children and adolescents using ultrasound radiomics.
36794166.patient_population: 164 pediatric patients with papillary thyroid cancer
36794166.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from ultrasound images of thyroid tumors are used to train and compare KNN, random forest, SVM, and LightGBM models to predict extrathyroidal extension, with SHAP used for interpretability.
36794166.study_design: retrospective cohort study, randomized to training/validation cohorts

36980083.clinical_problem: Systematically reviewing diagnostic performance of AI-based computer-aided detection/diagnosis systems across pediatric radiology subspecialties.
36980083.model_description: Systematic review of 23 studies evaluating AI-based CAD applications across pediatric brain, respiratory, musculoskeletal, urologic and cardiac imaging, especially pneumonia detection.
36980083.headline_result: Most studies reported AUC>=0.83, sensitivity>=0.84, specificity>=0.80, accuracy>=0.87

37161503.clinical_problem: Real-time decision support during fetal ultrasound to narrow the differential diagnosis of rare genetic syndromes based on observed phenotypic features.
37161503.patient_population: 549 perinatal phenotypes from two referral centers (France, UK)
37161503.model_description: At each step of a fetal ultrasound exam, a decision-support system suggests the next phenotypic feature to assess and outputs a ranked differential diagnosis of rare genetic syndromes.
37161503.headline_result: Ascertained diagnosis within top-10 list in 93% (full-phenotype) / 83% (stepwise) of syndromic cases; specificity 94-96%, sensitivity 84-99%
37161503.study_design: retrospective validation study using clinical data from two referral centers

37161929.clinical_problem: Classifying normal versus abnormal fetal heart ultrasound images and identifying ventricular septal defects to assist prenatal diagnosis of congenital heart disease.
37161929.model_description: YOLOv5 object detection models are trained on fetal echocardiography standard views to classify normal vs abnormal hearts and detect ventricular septal defects.
37161929.headline_result: YOLOv5n 82.93% accuracy on CHD test set; YOLOv5l 92.79% accuracy on VSD test set
37161929.study_design: retrospective model development and testing study

37193656.clinical_problem: Diagnosing developmental dysplasia of the hip in infants from ultrasound images using deep learning, according to the Graf classification.
37193656.patient_population: 60 infants (64 hips) with DDH, 131 healthy infants (262 hips), up to 6 months old
37193656.model_description: Pre-trained CNN models (SqueezeNet, MobileNet_v2, EfficientNet) are fine-tuned via transfer learning on hip ultrasound images to classify DDH versus normal hips, with Grad-CAM used for interpretability.
37193656.headline_result: Accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure all 1.0

37352995.clinical_problem: Discusses the need for a pediatric-specific AI curriculum and the challenges of AI education in pediatric radiology.
37352995.model_description: Discusses differences between pediatric and adult imaging relevant to AI model development (modality use, radiation dose, growth-related anatomic change, disease prevalence) and outlines needs for a dedicated pediatric radiology AI education curriculum.
37352995.study_design: commentary/perspective on AI education and curriculum development

37371851.clinical_problem: Screening for high-risk fetuses with common and rare genetic syndromes (Trisomy 21/18/13 and others) using facial and anatomical features on prenatal ultrasound.
37371851.model_description: A ResNet-based deep neural network (Pgds-ResNet) analyzes fetal ultrasound images to screen for genetic syndromes, generating heatmaps highlighting abnormal facial/anatomic features.
37371851.study_design: retrospective model development and comparative evaluation study

37509498.clinical_problem: Reviewing the role of AI/deep learning applied to DTI and fMRI for early autism spectrum disorder diagnosis.
37509498.model_description: Survey reviewing machine learning and deep learning techniques applied to diffusion tensor imaging and functional MRI for autism diagnosis and detection.

37606663.exclusion_reason: Scan inclusion criteria required age >=18 years; adult-only non-contrast brain CT population.

37683097.exclusion_reason: Conventional EEG microstate and fMRI temporal-variability statistical/mediation analysis in adolescents with depression; no AI/ML classification model described; EEG is non-radiologic imaging.

37945573.clinical_problem: Automated measurement of temporalis muscle thickness (a marker of lean muscle mass) on brain MRI to generate normal growth charts from childhood through adulthood.
37945573.patient_population: 23,876 brain MRIs of healthy subjects ages 4-35, plus validation in children with brain tumors
37945573.model_description: An automated deep learning pipeline measures temporalis muscle thickness (iTMT) on routine brain MRI, generating sex-specific normal growth charts with percentiles across ages 4-35.
37945573.study_design: retrospective cohort study with automated deep learning pipeline and multi-group validation

37999160.clinical_problem: Reviewing machine learning methods (classification, detection, segmentation) applied to fetal ultrasound images for anomaly detection.
37999160.model_description: Review of recent machine learning approaches for fetal ultrasound anomaly detection, covering classification, object recognition, and segmentation tasks.

38188914.clinical_problem: Detecting wrist fractures in children on radiographs using an optimized object detection algorithm.
38188914.model_description: A YOLOv7 object detection model, optimized through data preprocessing and configuration tuning, detects wrist fractures on pediatric radiographs; Grad-CAM used to visualize model attention.
38188914.headline_result: mAP@0.5 improved up to +25.51%, mAP@[0.5:0.95] improved up to +39.78% from preprocessing optimization
38188914.study_design: retrospective model development and optimization study using a public dataset

34191735.model_family: deep neural network + exclusivity regularized machine (meta-learning)
34191735.clinical_problem: Computer-aided diagnosis of developmental dysplasia of the hip in infants using B-mode ultrasound.
34191735.model_description: A two-stage meta-learning framework combining a deep neural network with an exclusivity regularized machine classifies infant hip ultrasound images for DDH diagnosis.

35063289.clinical_problem: Automated detection of low-lying placenta or placenta previa from 2D ultrasound in a resource-limited setting using low-cost equipment.
35063289.model_description: A U-Net deep learning model segments the placenta on 2D ultrasound images, and the segmentation is used to classify placental position as normal or low-lying/previa; deployed in real time on a smartphone with low-cost ultrasound.
35063289.dataset_size: 280 pregnant women, 6,574 training images; 148 holdout test cases
35063289.study_design: retrospective methods development and evaluation study in a resource-limited setting

35204353.clinical_problem: Predicting mitosis-karyorrhexis index (MKI) status of pediatric neuroblastoma non-invasively using PET/CT radiomics to guide further management.
35204353.model_description: Radiomics features extracted from 18F-FDG PET/CT images, selected via XGBoost, are combined with clinical characteristics into a radiomics nomogram predicting MKI status.

35246986.clinical_problem: Predicting neurodevelopmental disorders (ADHD, cognitive deficits in preterm infants) from brain connectome data derived from MRI.
35246986.patient_population: ADHD-200 dataset (adolescents) and Cincinnati Early Prediction Study (CINEPS) very preterm infant cohort
35246986.model_description: A deep convolutional neural network with multiple vector-shaped filters (ConCeptCNN) extracts topological features from brain connectome matrices to classify ADHD and predict cognitive deficits in very preterm infants.
35246986.headline_result: 78.7% accuracy for ADHD detection; 81.6% accuracy for cognitive deficit prediction in preterm infants
35246986.study_design: retrospective cohort study using public and institutional datasets

35281250.clinical_problem: Improving accuracy and consistency of bone age assessment among physicians of varying experience using AI-assisted reading of hand radiographs.
35281250.model_description: A deep learning convolutional neural network estimates bone age from hand radiographs, providing AI-assisted information to physicians to compare against unassisted assessments.
35281250.headline_result: MAE with AI 0.325/0.344/0.370 (senior/mid/junior) vs without AI 0.403/0.469/0.755, all p<0.001
35281250.study_design: retrospective reader study comparing physician performance with and without AI assistance

35281798.exclusion_reason: Uses large public chest radiograph collections without a stated pediatric-specific cohort; pediatric relevance for lateral CXR/TB detection is mentioned only as motivation, not as the study population.

35299255.exclusion_reason: Statistical reference-curve modeling (LMS growth-chart algorithm) of endocrine biomarkers; not an AI/ML imaging analysis. Ultrasound organ volume is only one of many biomarkers considered.

35361575.model_family: machine learning (6 candidate classifiers, sparse regression feature selection)
35361575.clinical_problem: Differentiating pediatric embryonal tumors, high-grade gliomas, and ependymomas using MRI radiomics to aid diagnosis, risk stratification, and treatment planning.
35361575.patient_population: 231 patients from 7 institutions (50 embryonal tumors, 127 high-grade gliomas, 54 ependymomas)
35361575.model_description: PyRadiomics features extracted from T2-weighted and gadolinium-enhanced T1-weighted MRI are reduced via sparse regression and used to train classifiers distinguishing pediatric supratentorial tumor types.
35361575.headline_result: AUC 0.98 (embryonal vs high-grade glioma), 0.82 (embryonal vs ependymoma), 0.96 (high-grade glioma vs ependymoma)

35460355.clinical_problem: Non-invasive prediction of MYCN gene amplification status in pediatric neuroblastoma using CT radiomics as a surrogate imaging biomarker.
35460355.model_description: Morphologic and radiomics texture features from contrast-enhanced CT are used to train an XGBoost model predicting MYCN amplification status, with accumulated local effects plots for interpretability.

35727944.clinical_problem: Characterizing white matter diffusion abnormalities in pediatric mild traumatic brain injury using multicompartmental diffusion models, and testing whether diffusion metrics improve diagnostic accuracy over clinical standards.
35727944.patient_population: 203 patients (8-18 years) and 170 matched healthy controls
35727944.model_description: Multicompartmental diffusion MRI models generate intracellular and free-water volume-fraction metrics; a random forest machine learning classifier uses these diffusion metrics alongside clinical standards to classify patients versus controls.
35727944.headline_result: Diffusion abnormalities increased overall diagnostic accuracy by ~10% over clinical gold standards

35731736.clinical_problem: Diagnosing cystic hygroma on first-trimester fetal ultrasound using deep learning.
35731736.patient_population: 289 sagittal fetal ultrasound images (129 cystic hygroma cases, 160 normal NT controls)
35731736.model_description: A DenseNet convolutional neural network classifies first-trimester fetal ultrasound images as cystic hygroma or normal, with Grad-CAM used to assess interpretability.
35731736.study_design: retrospective case-control study with internal validation

35809969.clinical_problem: Accurately estimating the diffusion tensor from few diffusion-weighted MRI measurements to enable shorter scans in non-cooperative patients such as neonates and infants.
35809969.model_description: Two sequential transformer networks estimate the diffusion tensor from as few as six diffusion-weighted measurements by learning relationships between diffusion signals and tensors in neighboring voxels.
35809969.headline_result: Estimations with 6 measurements comparable to standard methods using 30-88 measurements

35821715.exclusion_reason: COVID-19 vaccination epidemiology cohort study in school-aged children; no imaging or AI/ML component.

36093915.model_family: deep learning (unrolled neural network, DL-ESPIRiT variant)
36093915.clinical_problem: Accelerating 2D phase-contrast cardiac MRI flow measurements in children using deep learning reconstruction while maintaining accurate quantitative flow measurements.
36093915.patient_population: 155 fully sampled pediatric datasets (training); prospective cohort of 5 pediatric patients
36093915.model_description: A deep learning image-reconstruction framework (CD-DL) with Complex Difference estimation reconstructs highly undersampled 2D phase-contrast cardiac MRI, trained on pediatric datasets and validated retrospectively and prospectively against parallel imaging/compressed sensing methods.
36093915.headline_result: 9x acceleration within +/-5% accuracy/precision; peak velocity error 2.8% vs 3.9% (PICS)
36093915.study_design: retrospective and prospective model development/validation study

36260613.clinical_problem: Screening for biliary atresia in infants with jaundice using hepatobiliary ultrasound images and deep learning to assist non-specialist physicians.
36260613.patient_population: 180 patients (41 biliary atresia, 139 non-biliary atresia), 1,976 ultrasound images
36260613.model_description: Multiple deep learning CNN architectures (including ShuffleNet) classify hepatobiliary ultrasound images as biliary atresia or non-biliary atresia; a 'positive-dominance law' combines per-image predictions into a patient-level diagnosis.

36551961.exclusion_reason: Review of MRI radiogenomics in glioblastoma; adult brain tumor, not pediatric-specific.

36728734.exclusion_reason: General review of CT iterative reconstruction techniques; not specifically pediatric, with AI mentioned only briefly as a future perspective.

33647632.clinical_problem: Differentiating pediatric nonalcoholic fatty liver disease from healthy liver on ultrasound using texture-based machine learning classification.
33647632.patient_population: 93 normal subjects (484 ROIs), 39 NAFLD subjects (260 ROIs); external validation cohort of 42 children
33647632.model_description: Texture features extracted from regions of interest on hepatic ultrasound images are used to train an ensembled machine learning model (SVM, neural network, XGBoost) to classify liver images as NAFLD or normal.
33647632.dataset_size: 132 subjects total (93 normal, 39 NAFLD) plus a 42-child external validation cohort
33647632.headline_result: Ensembled ML model superior to intensity-based indices in external validation of 211 ROIs from 42 children
33647632.study_design: cross-sectional study with external validation cohort

33711613.exclusion_reason: Markerless video-based motion capture/pose estimation for gait analysis; uses RGB video, not a radiologic imaging modality (X-ray/CT/MRI/US).

33734521.exclusion_reason: Conventional resting-state fMRI functional connectivity analysis of subconcussive head impacts in youth football; no AI/ML model described.

33891778.clinical_problem: Automatically assessing image quality of reconstructed 3D fetal brain MRI to reduce the need for time-consuming manual visual inspection.
33891778.patient_population: 271 MR exams from 211 fetuses (mean gestational age 30.9+/-5.5 weeks)
33891778.model_description: Three multi-instance deep learning models (count-based, vote-based, feature-embedding) classify 3D fetal brain MRI reconstructions as high or low quality, optionally using gestational age as an input.
33891778.headline_result: Best model (MI-CB-DLM with gestational age): accuracy 0.86, AUC 0.93
33891778.study_design: retrospective methods development and validation study

34071202.clinical_problem: Reviewing deep learning techniques applied to pediatric brain tumor imaging (diagnosis, classification, segmentation) and associated challenges.
34071202.model_description: Narrative review summarizing deep learning research on pediatric brain tumor MRI/CT imaging, including diagnostic clues (age, location, incidence) and technical/medical limitations.

34096674.exclusion_reason: Automated signal-processing algorithm (myocardial velocity trace integration) for measuring cardiac excursion; no explicit AI/ML method described.

34240783.clinical_problem: Estimating brain-predicted age difference (BrainPAD) from multimodal MRI (morphometry and connectomes) as an indicator of psychiatric and cognitive functioning in youth.
34240783.patient_population: 489 participants from the Healthy Brain Network (training/test split)
34240783.model_description: A stacked ensemble AutoML approach combines multiple machine learning algorithms applied to brain morphometry and white matter connectome features from MRI to estimate brain-predicted age difference (BrainPAD), a marker linked to psychiatric symptoms.
34240783.headline_result: MAE 1.18 years (combined model); MAE 0.26 years after ComBat harmonization
34240783.study_design: retrospective cohort study using a public dataset

34357510.model_family: CNN (transfer learning: Inception ResNet v2, MobileNetV2)
34357510.clinical_problem: Automatically measuring hip migration percentage on pelvis radiographs to assess hip displacement in children with cerebral palsy.
34357510.model_description: Two fine-tuned CNNs (Inception ResNet v2, then MobileNetV2) detect landmark locations on pelvis radiographs to automatically calculate hip migration percentage.
34357510.headline_result: Mean absolute difference 4.5+/-4.3%, ICC 0.91; sensitivity/specificity 87.8%/93.4% (30% MP threshold)
34357510.study_design: retrospective methods development and validation study

34368247.clinical_problem: Identifying risk factors, including pre-operative echocardiographic right ventricular function, for post-operative complications after Tetralogy of Fallot repair in children.
34368247.patient_population: 162 children <2 years with Tetralogy of Fallot undergoing surgical repair
34368247.model_description: Gradient-boosted machine learning models use patient, operative, and echocardiographic variables (including pre-operative RV strain and fractional area change) to identify predictors of post-operative cardiac complications.
34368247.headline_result: 26.5% had at least one post-operative complication; cardiopulmonary bypass duration was the highest-ranked predictor

34392363.model_family: sequential machine learning classifier (logistic regression, neural network)
34392363.clinical_problem: Distinguishing pediatric posterior fossa tumor types (pilocytic astrocytoma, medulloblastoma, ependymoma) on MRI to aid diagnosis and surgical planning.
34392363.model_description: A 2-step sequential machine-learning classifier first distinguishes pilocytic astrocytoma from other tumors using T2/T1 radiomics features (logistic regression), then distinguishes medulloblastoma from ependymoma (neural network) using MRI Image Biomarker Standardization Initiative features.
34392363.dataset_size: 527 patients (274 medulloblastoma, 156 pilocytic astrocytoma, 97 ependymoma), multinational
34392363.headline_result: F1 scores: 0.8809 (PA vs non-PA), 0.9189 (MB vs EP), 0.9179 combined

34428783.exclusion_reason: Standard fMRI activation comparison study of visuospatial working memory and arithmetic; no AI/ML model.

34476196.clinical_problem: Reducing contrast medium and radiation dose in pediatric coronary CT angiography using deep learning image reconstruction while maintaining image quality.
34476196.patient_population: 27 pediatric arrhythmic patients (study group), 27 matched controls
34476196.model_description: A deep learning image-reconstruction algorithm processes low-dose, low-contrast coronary CT angiography scans acquired at 70 kVp with a shortened contrast-injection protocol, compared to standard-dose scans reconstructed with iterative reconstruction.
34476196.headline_result: Contrast dose reduced 53% to 15.07+/-3.68 mL; radiation dose reduced 36% to 0.57+/-0.31 mSv; similar image quality scores

34518201.exclusion_reason: Newborn gestational-age estimation using anthropometric and physical-exam features (birth weight, head/chest circumference, foot length, etc.); no imaging component.

34610500.clinical_problem: Automated segmentation of all four fetal cardiac chambers on echocardiography to assist diagnosis of fetal heart disease.
34610500.model_description: A Category Attention Instance Segmentation Network with category, mask, and category-attention branches segments all four fetal cardiac chambers simultaneously from echocardiography images.
34610500.headline_result: Dice coefficients 0.7956/0.7619/0.8199/0.7470 for the four chambers; average precision 45.64%

34870211.clinical_problem: Enabling reduced-dose FDG PET/MRI in children and young adults with lymphoma using deep learning image augmentation while preserving accurate treatment response assessment.
34870211.model_description: An FDA-approved convolutional neural network augments simulated low-dose FDG PET/MRI images to full-dose-equivalent quality, evaluated for correct treatment response classification in pediatric and young adult lymphoma patients.
34870211.release_evidence: A U.S. Food and Drug Administration-approved CNN was used to augment input simulated low-dose scans to full-dose scans.
34870211.headline_result: 100% sensitivity and specificity for response assessment using 75%/50% simulated dose + CNN augmentation
34870211.study_design: secondary analysis of prospectively collected clinical trial data (NCT01542879)

35071361.exclusion_reason: Predicts congenital heart disease risk from maternal questionnaire and clinical laboratory data; ultrasound imaging is used only to establish the ground-truth diagnosis, not as a model input.

32023935.clinical_problem: Improving prediction of fetal macrosomia and large-for-gestational-age status from prenatal ultrasound biometric measurements.
32023935.patient_population: Data from the Successive Small-for-Gestational-Age-Births study
32023935.model_description: Ensemble machine learning methods (voting and stacking) combine 26 empirical fetal weight estimation formulas and statistical models based on prenatal ultrasound measurements to improve prediction of macrosomia and large-for-gestational-age infants.
32023935.study_design: retrospective cohort study using ensemble learning methods

32849251.clinical_problem: Predicting outcome of deep brain stimulation of the globus pallidus internus in children with dystonia using clinical, neurophysiological, and cranial MRI features.
32849251.patient_population: 133 children who underwent DBS with 1-year outcome data (of 244 assessed)
32849251.model_description: A decision tree classifier uses six patient parameters (sex, dystonia etiology, baseline severity, cranial MRI findings, and two neurophysiological tests) to predict 1-year outcome after deep brain stimulation in children with dystonia.
